style.direction: warm-neutral premium small-appliance ecommerce, saturated pine-green studio wall alternating with clean white infographic panels and one light oak plank surface
style.iconSystem: solid radial-gradient discs falling #52866D into #2F6049, each carrying exactly one distinct thin-line white glyph drawn from the airflow, speed, timer, handle, filter and quiet-operation family, maximum six discs per screen; plus white pill rows holding one small green clover glyph and one short label, maximum four pills per screen; terracotta #DE8440 is reserved for a single data accent on one screen; no pictogram invented inside an empty disc, no repeated identical label, no certificate seal

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm-neutral premium small-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a saturated pine-green studio wall #4B7A66, a deeper pine-green closing band #2B5A48, flat white infographic panels #FFFFFF, one light oak plank tabletop #E3C49B with a thin edge shadow #C9A476, charcoal headline ink #2D2D2D on white and pure #FFFFFF ink on green, the product's own champagne-toned metal frame #C6A179 over a pale shell #F6F5F2 and a dark fine mesh outlet #1A1C1B, and one terracotta data accent #DE8440 reserved for a single screen; neutral tone held by the warm oak against the cool green wall, never a neon or gel cast, never a black studio; backgrounds limited to the pine-green wall with a soft sheer-curtain bloom at the upper left closed by the deep band #2B5A48, the flat white panel #FFFFFF, and rooms rendered in the same green and pale-linen family, no third background, no marble, no outdoor scenery; soft diffused 5500K key from the upper left with a broad low-contrast fill at the right, a faint warm rim on the metal frame only, and one honest contact shadow always grounding the unit, never a hard shadow and never a floating product; surfaces limited to the oak plank #E3C49B, a matte pale-linen floor #EDEAE2 and the white panel #FFFFFF; one modern geometric sans-serif only, two-line headline placeholders at 30-44pt in #FFFFFF or #2D2D2D, one 16pt sub-line, 12-14pt labels, one thin hairline rule under every headline, every Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」 and kept short, no decorative latin filler; stable presentation of the unit as one slim vertical tower body with a #C6A179 oval frame around a fine dark #1A1C1B mesh outlet face, a glossy dark upper control band #121413 with one ring dial, a tapered neck and a flat round base #F6F5F2, at constant scale, on its contact shadow, never duplicated outside the deliberate card arrays, never cropped through the oval frame mid-radius;
